criteria.title: Environment-configured links appear in sidebar
criteria.blocker: This criterion requires setting REACT_NAV_LINKS environment variable before building the application. The QA environment has a pre-built app and cannot inject environment variables at runtime. Build-time configuration cannot be changed without rebuilding the entire application, which is outside the scope of live QA verification.

seed_attempt.summary: Build-time environment variable configuration required. Code review of care.config.ts parsing logic confirms correct implementation. Manual verification steps documented in qa-plan.md. Automated E2E tests cover baseline behavior in tests/sidebar/navLinks.spec.ts.

criteria.title: Plugin nav items are injected
criteria.blocker: Test environment does not have plugins enabled (REACT_ENABLED_APPS is not configured). Plugin nav item injection cannot be demonstrated without a configured plugin manifest.

seed_attempt.summary: No plugins configured in test environment. Code review confirms: facility-nav.tsx lines 222-225 retrieve plugin items via useCareApps(), lines 212-215 map plugin links with facility URL prefix. admin-nav.tsx lines 89-92 retrieve plugin items, line 83 appends after env links. Ordering preserved: [...links, ...processedEnvLinks, ...pluginNavItems].

criteria.title: Links display with configured properties (icon, external, new tab)
criteria.blocker: Same limitation as AC1: requires REACT_NAV_LINKS environment variable before building. Cannot demonstrate external link properties without configured custom links in the running application.

seed_attempt.summary: Build-time configuration required. Code review of src/Utils/navLinks.tsx confirms processEnvNavLinks() detects external URLs (http:// or https:// prefix), adds ExternalLink icon, sets external: true. nav-main.tsx NavLink component handles external attribute with target='_blank' and rel='noopener noreferrer'. E2E tests cover external link handling patterns.

criteria.title: Invalid JSON logs console warning
criteria.blocker: Same limitation as AC1: requires setting REACT_NAV_LINKS with invalid JSON before building. Cannot demonstrate error handling without triggering the build-time parse error.

seed_attempt.summary: Build-time configuration required. Code review of care.config.ts lines 425-458 confirms comprehensive error handling: try-catch wraps JSON.parse(), validates Array.isArray(), filters links with missing name/url, logs console.warn() for each error type, returns [] for graceful degradation. Three console warning messages documented for different error conditions.
